_comment: HCLS AI Factory capability manifest. status=live means real & running; status=planned means on the roadmap (not yet real). A LIVE capability may never be MOCK-served (enforced by the registry's honesty rule). Optional maturity (verified|preclinical|research-use|roadmap|gated) is an honest evidence/access tier orthogonal to status — set only where documented; maturity=verified requires a live, non-mock capability.

capabilities.name: Genomics Foundations Engine
capabilities.description: GPU germline variant calling: FASTQ to BAM to VCF via accelerated alignment (fq2bam/BWA-MEM2) and DeepVariant. Script/pipeline-invoked (Parabricks in Docker via run.sh/run_caller.sh), not yet a request/response API. ClinVar/AlphaMissense annotation is served by the Precision Intelligence Engine (E2, :5001); E1 produces the QC'd variant substrate E2 annotates.

capabilities.name: Precision Intelligence Engine
capabilities.description: Variant annotation (ClinVar/AlphaMissense) + RAG interpretation over the shared variant foundation to identify and contextualize druggable targets. Decision support for a qualified clinician, not diagnosis. (An Ensembl VEP container ships as an optional, manually-run annotator; it is not in the automated interpretation path.)

capabilities.name: Therapeutic Discovery Engine
capabilities.description: Target to ranked drug candidates: generation, docking, and RDKit scoring across a 10-stage pipeline. (Honesty: the 10-stage chemistry (RDKit QED/conformers/ranking) is real and live; molecule generation currently uses the real RDKit BRICS backend, the BioNeMo/MolMIM path is not deployed, and stage-7 docking requires the DiffDock NIM.)

capabilities.name: MolMIM Generator
capabilities.description: Generative small-molecule design from a seed compound (accelerated inference microservice; local/cloud, mock fallback labeled). Runtime requires the MolMIM NIM container (NGC + GPU) deployed; a clearly-labeled mock fallback exists for development.

capabilities.name: DiffDock Docking
capabilities.description: Protein-ligand blind docking / 3D pose prediction (accelerated inference microservice; local/cloud, mock fallback labeled). Runtime requires the DiffDock NIM container (NGC + GPU) deployed; a clearly-labeled mock fallback exists for development.

capabilities.name: Precision Oncology Engine
capabilities.description: MTB packet generation, therapy ranking, and trial matching, with cross-modal joins to the imaging, biomarker, and trial capabilities; fusion-first pediatric MTB, late-effects-weighted ranking, Pediatric MATCH/COG matching. Decision support.

capabilities.name: CAR-T Intelligence Agent
capabilities.description: RAG decision support for CAR-T; stores scFv/antibody sequences.

capabilities.name: Precision Biomarker Intelligence Agent
capabilities.description: RAG decision support for biomarker analysis.

capabilities.name: Cardiology Engine
capabilities.description: 11 clinical workflows and 6 risk calculators spanning prevention, intervention, and rhythm; CAC + 10-year ASCVD prevention logic (ACC/AHA), handing to Pharmacogenomics for the genetically safe drug. Decision support.

capabilities.name: Neurology Intelligence Agent
capabilities.description: RAG decision support across 10 neurology domains (Parkinson's, Alzheimer's, dementia, ALS, MS, ...).

capabilities.name: Precision Autoimmune Intelligence Agent
capabilities.description: RAG decision support for autoimmune disease.

capabilities.name: Rare Disease Intelligence Agent
capabilities.description: RAG decision support for rare disease diagnosis.

capabilities.name: Pharmacogenomics Intelligence Agent
capabilities.description: RAG decision support + PGx drug-metabolism filtering.

capabilities.name: Clinical Imaging Engine
capabilities.description: Live DICOM analysis (VISTA-3D segmentation, VILA-M3 image/report reasoning, FHIR R4 export) with cross-modality reasoning against genomics. MAISI synthetic imaging is research/augmentation/QA only, never diagnostic. Decision support. (Honesty: the live-verified modality is chest X-ray analysis via DenseNet-121 on real DICOM pixels; the VISTA-3D / VILA-M3 CT path is a planned/placeholder modality, not yet live.)

capabilities.name: Single-Cell Intelligence Agent
capabilities.description: Reasoning layer over the Single-Cell Engine (Engine 8). RAG clinical interpretation of the engine's computed cell-type clusters plus literature: cell-type annotation, TME profiling (hot/cold/excluded), drug-response, subclonal architecture, and ligand-receptor analysis. Distinct from the 'singlecell-compute' engine that produces the clusters it reasons over — the engine computes, the agent interprets. Not a duplicate.

capabilities.name: Clinical Trial Intelligence Agent
capabilities.description: RAG decision support for trial matching.

capabilities.name: Tuberous Sclerosis Engine
capabilities.description: Disease-program engine orchestrating 5 sub-agents (variant curator, trajectory modeler, therapeutics strategist, phenome mapper, TAND surveillance).

capabilities.name: Vector Database
capabilities.description: Milvus vector store backing all RAG retrieval + similarity indexes.

capabilities.name: Verify Gate
capabilities.description: Deterministic clinical-overclaim honesty register + adversarial claim refutation.

capabilities.name: Reproducibility Manifest
capabilities.description: Per-run software/model/reference/hardware manifest (21 CFR Part 11 framing).

capabilities.name: Event Bus
capabilities.description: File-audited cross-stage event fabric with bidirectional triggers.

capabilities.name: Observability
capabilities.description: Prometheus + Grafana metrics/dashboards.

capabilities.name: ESMFold Structure Prediction
capabilities.description: Real single-sequence protein structure prediction (sequence -> PDB + per-residue pLDDT). GPU-served on the GB10 (cu130 torch + half-precision): VCP-scale (806 aa) in ~1s, ~6x faster than CPU. POST /fold.

capabilities.name: Protein Sequence Search
capabilities.description: ESM-2 (650M, 1280-dim) embeddings on the GB10 GPU + Milvus similarity search. Verified: ubiquitin query self-retrieves cosine=1.0, variant 0.997. Reuses the platform vector DB. POST /embed /index /search. B3: optional exact Smith-Waterman re-rank (Biopython local alignment) on the ANN top-k for retrieve-then-rerank precision (%identity + alignment score).

capabilities.name: GenMol Generator
capabilities.description: SAFE-fragment masked-diffusion molecule generation (diversity complement to MolMIM).

capabilities.name: ADMET / Toxicity Prediction
capabilities.description: Trained D-MPNN suite predicting 104 ADMET endpoints per molecule (hERG, Ames, DILI, CYP inhibition, BBB, solubility, clearance...) with a flag/verdict summary. Replaces Lipinski/QED heuristics. Verified on GPU: caffeine BBB=0.98 (correctly CNS-penetrant), ibuprofen clean. POST /admet {smiles}.

capabilities.name: Single-Cell Analysis Engine
capabilities.description: Engine 8 compute layer. Real scanpy scRNA-seq workflow (QC -> normalize -> HVG -> PCA -> Leiden clustering -> marker DE) + marker-based cell-type annotation. Verified on PBMC 3k: 2700 cells -> 9 clusters -> CD4 T / B / NK / CD14+ & FCGR3A+ Monocytes / Dendritic / Megakaryocytes. Produces the cell-type clusters the Single-Cell Intelligence Agent reasons over (the engine computes, the agent interprets) — and a shared capability other engines/agents can call (e.g. oncology TME, the multi-omics join). POST /analyze. GPU (rapids-singlecell) is the upgrade.

capabilities.name: Assistant Tool-Surface (MCP)
capabilities.description: Exposes this registry as MCP tools (list/describe/health/invoke/plan) so AI assistants can drive the factory. Built + tested; run via `python -m hcls_common.mcp_server`.

capabilities.name: AI Workflow Composer
capabilities.description: Natural-language goal -> validated, executable, governed pipeline over the registry: deterministic shape-based wiring, self-repair, pre-run validation, governed execution, AI root-cause. Verified end-to-end: 'predict ADMET for aspirin' -> composed pipeline -> live ADMET service -> real result. Invoke via MCP compose_workflow.

capabilities.name: Molecule Generator (diversity)
capabilities.description: De novo / scaffold-constrained molecule generation for diversity, alongside MolMIM. ACTIVE backend: RDKit BRICS fragment recombination (real, verified — decompose seed actives -> recombine -> novel valid molecules, QED-scored). Optional learned SAFE-fragment model (GenMol family) auto-engages in a transformers<5 env (graceful fallback to BRICS otherwise). NVIDIA GenMol NIM = GPU-accelerated variant. POST /generate.

capabilities.name: Local MLOps
capabilities.description: Single-box experiment tracking + model registry + run lineage (SQLite, no warehouse). Logs params/metrics/artifacts + reproducibility manifest per run; versions + stages models (staging/production); queryable best-run/production. Verified: tracked this session's real runs (ESMFold/ADMET/single-cell). hcls_common.get_mlops_store().

capabilities.name: Queryable Variant Store
capabilities.description: VCF -> DuckDB columnar store: SQL/region queries by chrom/pos/filter/sample, PASS-vs-RefCall aware, with Ts/Tv QC. Verified on real HG002 PASS SNVs: Ts/Tv~2.0 (human ~2.0-2.1). Adds a QC trust-gate report (Ts/Tv, het/hom, SNV/indel, verdict pass|warn|fail) at GET /qc that withholds interpretation on a bad call set. Plus a caller option (run_caller.sh: DeepVariant|HaplotypeCaller). POST /query /load, GET /stats /qc.

capabilities.name: Protein Developability + Design
capabilities.description: B4 developability scoring: real biophysical proxies (GRAVY, Guruprasad instability index, pI, aromaticity, MW) + flag/verdict. B3 design: developability-guided single-point mutation optimizer (proposes substitutions that lower instability, computed). Verified: E31K lowers instability 36.0->28.2. Structure-conditioned design (ProteinMPNN/RFdiffusion) + MHCflurry immunogenicity = follow-on. POST /score /optimize. Code is real and correct (confirmed on real human lysozyme: pI 9.28, MW 14700, stable), but Biopython is not installable in the reference box's PEP 668-managed runtime, so the service cannot import as-is; planned until the dependency ships.

capabilities.name: VAF / Somatic-Mosaicism Flag
capabilities.description: Read-backed VAF (AD/DP) per PASS call + low-VAF mosaic-candidate flag (default 0.02-0.35, DP>=30). The diagnostic trap standard germline pipelines drop (mosaic TSC1/TSC2). Evidence for the Rare Disease agent - NOT a classification. POST /mosaic on :8575.

capabilities.name: ACMG SF Secondary Findings
capabilities.description: Rules layer flagging annotated variants in the ACMG SF v3.2 panel (82 genes, 40 conditions) with reportable (likely-)pathogenic significance. Deterministic gene x significance join over the annotation output. Validate panel vs official publication before clinical use.

capabilities.name: pMHC-I Immunogenicity (MHCflurry)
capabilities.description: MHCflurry 2.x (Apache-2.0) class-I HLA presentation prediction. Reference result: NLVPMVATV vs HLA-A*02:01 -> presentation 0.97 / 17nM (correct strong epitope). Sliding-window scan -> per-allele immunogenic-epitope burden for biologic developability + neoantigen pre-screen. POST /scan /predict. The mhcflurry package is not installed on the reference box (import fails), so the service cannot start as-is; planned until the dependency is present.

capabilities.name: ProteinMPNN Inverse Folding
capabilities.description: Structure-conditioned sequence design (MIT): backbone PDB -> amino-acid sequences predicted to fold into it, with ProteinMPNN score + native seq-recovery. Verified: 5L33 backbone -> designs at ~45% seq-recovery (expected range). Chains to ESMFold for re-fold validation + to de-novo backbones. POST /design.

capabilities.name: ESM-2 LoRA Fine-Tuning
capabilities.description: Parameter-efficient (LoRA) domain fine-tuning of ESM-2 for a custom protein property (regression/classification) on the GB10 GPU. Reference result: learns lysine-count signal (loss 5.05->2.07) with only 1.2% trainable params. Path to bespoke solubility/activity/stability predictors without external repos. Library/in-process (finetune+predict). The peft dependency is not installed on the reference box (import fails); not runnable as-is, planned until present.

capabilities.name: GWAS Association Testing
capabilities.description: Single-box GWAS: per-variant logistic-regression association vs a binary phenotype (+ covariates, MAF filter, Manhattan output), pure Python (statsmodels), no Spark. Verified: detects a causal variant (p<0.001, OR>1) while a null variant is n.s.; separation handled gracefully. Complements the DuckDB variant store (E3) at single-box scale.

capabilities.name: Chai-1 Complex Structure Prediction
capabilities.description: Chai-1 (Apache-2.0 code+weights, commercial-OK): AlphaFold3-class multimodal structure prediction — proteins, small-molecule ligands, DNA/RNA, glycans, and COMPLEXES. Fills the complex co-folding gap ESMFold cannot (single-sequence only). STATUS: registered, BUILD IN PROGRESS — pip install chai_lab -> try GB10 (modern torch+bf16) else RunPod A100/L40S/H100 -> FastAPI /fold -> flip planned->live. Primary: Large-Molecule Engine + Therapeutic Discovery (structure-based design); strong: Oncology, Rare-Disease, CAR-T, Autoimmune, Neurology (VCP/FTD demo). Chains: RFdiffusion->ProteinMPNN->Chai-1 validate. POST /fold.

capabilities.name: Chai-2 De Novo Antibody / Binder Design
capabilities.description: Chai-2 (Chai Discovery): zero-shot antibody / protein-binder design. ACCESS GATED — commercial frontier via Chai's platform/partnership, NOT open weights. INTEGRATION ROADMAP: (1) outreach to Chai leading with the Chai-1 integration showcase + mutual-acceleration; (2) secure platform/partnership access; (3) register as cloud_nim/external endpoint + wire into the binder-design family (CAR-T scFv binding domains, autoimmune autoantibody design); (4) chain with Chai-1 (design -> validate binder-antigen complex). Benefits: CAR-T, Precision Autoimmune, biologics. Contingent on access.
